text: せんちょうさん　みたんだけど　ぐあい　わるいって　まっさおな　かお　してたよ！

structure.jp: せんちょうさん　みたんだけど
ぐあい　わるいって
まっさおな　かお　してたよ！

patterns.name: 〜んだけど
patterns.explanation: んだけど sets up background before the real point, like 'so, I did this, and...'. みたんだけど = 'I saw him, and...'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: ぐあい　わるいって
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and shows that the words before it are what someone said. ぐあい わるいって = 'he said he feels unwell'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says a state is ongoing, and てた is the shortened past form of it. かお してた = 'had a face that looked like that'.
